Based on the information below, the battles of [[Nentan]], [[Tiems]] and [[Dankayo/Legends|Dankayo]] can be placed in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]:
*{{FactFile2014|10|RIE 1-2|General Rieekan}} places the battles of Nentan, Tiems and Dankayo between the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]] and the [[Evacuation of Yavin]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates respectively to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and 0 ABY.
*{{DB|character|generalcarlistrieekan|Rieekan, General Carlist}} and ''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 10 place the battle of Nentan before Tiems and Dankayo. 
*According to ''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]'', [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]] was promoted [[Captain/Legends|captain]] to [[Major/Legends|major]] after the battle of Nentan.
*According to ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]'', Derlin was still a captain during the [[Defense of Ralltiir]], not long after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], so in 0 ABY. ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' confirmed that Derlin was still a captain after the Battle of Yavin.
*Hence, the battles of Tiems and Dankayo follow the battle of Nentan, that follows the Defense of Ralltiir in 0 ABY.
Furthermore, events in 0 ABY before the Evacuation of Yavin are concurrent to the [[Yavin blockade]] per ''The New Essential Chronology''.
